results.title: Hambre
results.overview: In crisis-stricken Venezuela, two former schoolmates run into each other years after graduating and face a question that puts their identity to test. Will they rebuild their homeland or be forced to migrate?

results.title: Warriors of the Wasteland
results.overview: In a distant future following a nuclear catastrophe, the West Balkans have become a lawless wasteland where the most valuable currency is the bullet. A mysterious blind fiddler wanders the ruins, singing the legend of the "Grain People"—a peaceful community of wheat-growers who refuse to submit to a distant city's tyranny. When a young warrior’s family is slaughtered by a deranged warlord, he embarks on a bloody quest for vengeance. Armed only with a blade and a motorcycle, he must navigate radioactive cults and hallucinations to protect the last remnants of civilization.

results.title: Duchess
results.overview: A tough, working-class petty criminal is drawn into the treacherous world of diamond smuggling and morphs into an anti-heroine to be reckoned with in the murky underworld.

results.title: Cursed
results.overview: An American drifter is cursed and undergoes a supernatural transformation after arriving in a rural Romanian village and stealing from a produce stand.

results.title: Coal
results.overview: Eesa and Mokhtar, who work at the mine, argue; Eesa pushes Mokhtar and makes him fall. Mokhtar's oxygen tank starts leaking without anyone noticing. Eesa finds methane and saves several people but Mokhtar dies from lack of oxygen in his bottle. Eesa is torn and must make a choice: lie, which would make him a hero, or confess everything and carry the burden of having killed Mokhtar.

results.title: The Promise
results.overview: Maja has made a promise to her deceased sister: she will take care of her 15-year-old nephew Mathias, who has fallen into bad company and been kidnapped. Now the kidnappers are threatening to kill Mathias, and the problem is that Maja is sitting in a car far away. As the situation escalates, she must overcome her inner fears in an attempt to save Mathias.

results.title: Differently, Still
results.overview: Differently, Still depicts a day in the life of a professional skateboarder, and a young boy learning skateboarding for the first time, as their lives intersect.

results.title: My Home Hero the Movie
results.original_title: 映画 マイホームヒーロー
results.overview: Seven years have passed since family man Tetsuo Tosu survived a fierce battle with a criminal organization. However, Tetsuo's peaceful family life begins to crumble once again when a sudden landslide uncovers an old sin.

On November 11, 1918, amidst the chaos of the western front, a German aviator narrowly escapes death in a crash near a Belgian trench. Forced to conceal his identity, he embarks on a perilous journey to evade capture and reunite with his comrades. However, as suspicions arise among his adversaries, his covert mission becomes increasingly fraught with danger.

results.title: Starve Acre
results.overview: When their son starts acting strangely, a couple unwittingly allow dark and sinister forces into their home, awakening a long-dormant ancient evil rooted deep in the countryside.

results.title: Longing
results.overview: A business mogul runs into his old small town girlfriend while she is visiting the big city only to find out that they had a child together that he was unaware of.

results.title: Fancy Dance
results.overview: Following her sister's disappearance, Jax and her niece Roki must stick together. Desperate to keep what's left of their family intact, Jax and Roki defy the law and hit the road on a journey to the Grand Nation Powwow in Oklahoma City.

results.title: Fast
results.overview: Overweight Jake begins to lose his sanity after being put on an extended fast by his intense personal trainer.

results.title: Mother
results.overview: After being clinically dead for over 2 hours, a mother begins acting strangely...

results.title: Love Stories
results.overview: On Valentine's Day, four well-known directors of the country created four short films focused on love.

results.title: Festa Major
results.overview: Four days of joy and friendship in a village in the Pyrenees. The festivities intensify life together, and cinema glorifies it.

results.title: Dream #1
results.overview: A short film based on a dream of being chased by the People's Liberation Army to the sounds of Tammy Wynette

results.title: Rumours
results.overview: En route to the annual G7 summit, the seven leaders of the world’s wealthiest liberal democracies get lost in the woods and face increasing peril while attempting to draft a provisional statement regarding a global crisis.

results.title: Paris Tokyo
results.overview: Sam hasn't heard from Gabby, with whom she has an online relationship. On a whim, she arrives in Paris, determined to find her and meet her for real.

results.title: Cult Killer
results.overview: A private investigator is forced into a dangerous alliance with a killer in order to uncover a quiet town’s grisly criminal underbelly and clear the name of her mentor, who is implicated in the crimes.
